idea-plugin.name: Oktopios Language
idea-plugin.description:
Oktopios Language adds support for Oktopios source files in JetBrains IDEs.

The plugin recognizes .okp files and provides a cleaner editing experience for Oktopios projects.

  • Syntax highlighting for Oktopios keywords, types, constants, strings, numbers, operators, and comments.
  • File type registration for .okp files.
  • Line and block comment support.
  • Brace, parenthesis, and bracket matching.
  • Color settings page for customizing the Oktopios editor theme.
  • Basic run action for launching the current file with the okp command.

Source code: GitHub repository.
